stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Jodie Tancredi leading on 41 pts - the ladder doesn't lie, except about Fremantle apparently

stories.title: Not Our Problem
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 1 & 5 - the course just surrendered

stories.title: Don't Mind Me
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 1 - just casually

stories.title: Case Closed
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 13 - that'll do nicely

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: 20 on the back nine after 13 on the front - flying home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 156 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: Blood on the Board
stories.detail: Cate and Joe Redfern both travelling nicely - the family sedan is full of golf clubs again

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 11 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 17, 3-pointer on hole 18 - that's better

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 6 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 4 & 5

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 5 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: Committed to the One-Pointer
stories.detail: 9 1-pointers - every hole is a 1-pointer and that is the plan

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 16, wipe on hole 17 - the course corrects

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 15 & 16 - feast then famine

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 12 & 13 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Was up at 4th, now 15th - wheels wobbling
